errors.text: The proposed critical L12 order parameters are unsupported and internally inconsistent: the brittle state is assigned η ≈ 0.85, whereas the boundary is later defined as η dropping below approximately 0.75.
The cited evidence concerns materially different alloy systems and does not establish APBE, L12-order thresholds, SISFE changes, or jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary embrittlement in AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
